name: Qiskit
description: Qiskit is an open-source SDK for quantum computing developed by IBM. It provides tools for creating and running quantum circuits on simulators and real IBM quantum hardware. Qiskit supports applications in chemistry, optimization, machine learning, and more.

sources.title: IBM Improves Qubit Reset by 25x and Releases Qiskit v2.5 - Quantum Computing Report

news.title: Qiskit SDK v2.5 released with new C API capabilities and improved transpiler performance
news.excerpt: Qiskit v2.5 introduced classical control flow inspection in the C API, new preset pass managers for Pauli-based computation and Clifford+T representations, and major transpiler performance improvements. IBM also announced renaming the Qiskit Runtime Service to IBM Quantum Compute Service.

news.title: Qiskit 2.5.0 released with multi-IR staged pass manager and expanded C API
news.excerpt: Qiskit 2.5.0 introduces a multi-IR staged pass manager for flexible compilation across intermediate representations, expands the C API with control flow and classical expression support, and adds multi-threaded gate optimization and parallelized unitary synthesis. Minimum NumPy version raised to 2.0.

news.title: Qiskit 2.5.2 released
news.excerpt: IBM released Qiskit 2.5.2, a patch update to the open-source quantum computing SDK addressing bug fixes and stability improvements.
